en.headline: Hang Seng Index falls 439 points to 22855 at midday below 23000
en.dek: The benchmark dropped 1.89 percent by noon as Tencent and Alibaba led losses among blue chips, with main board turnover near HK$123 billion.
body: Hong Kong stocks extended losses on Thursday, with the Hang Seng Index falling below the 23000 level for the first time in nearly three weeks.
The index closed the morning session at 22855 points, down 439 points or 1.89 percent, after earlier touching a low near 22800. Main board turnover reached about HK$123 billion in the half-day.

Technology shares weighed heavily. Tencent fell nearly 7 percent after results, while Alibaba dropped nearly 6 percent. The Hang Seng Tech Index declined about 2 percent to 3661 points. Financial stocks including HSBC, AIA and HKEX also eased around 2 percent.
Chip stocks were mixed, with Hua Hong Semiconductor rising sharply while some others fell. The market remained under pressure amid technology sector concerns.

zh.headline: 恒生指數半日跌439點失守23000點
zh.dek: 恒指中午報22855點，跌1.89%，騰訊及阿里巴巴領跌藍籌，半日主板成交額近1234億元。
body: 港股周四延續跌勢，恒生指數失守23000點關口，是近三星期以來首次。
恒指半日收市報22855點，跌439點，跌幅1.89%，早段一度低見近22800點。半日主板成交額近1234億元。
科技股大幅下挫。騰訊績後跌近7%，阿里巴巴跌近6%，兩者為跌幅最大藍籌。科技指數跌約2%報3661點。滙控、友邦及港交所等金融股亦跌近2%。
晶片股個別發展，華虹宏力急升，部分其他股份則回落。大市持續受科技板塊沽壓影響。
